code_findings.finding: There is no hard two-step relay limit in the CLI wave path. A promoted B can remain pending across pumps and submit C before B is finished.
code_findings.limits: Successor admission requires imported Source, at least six ready steps, warm next direction, and quota/remaining/context for four outputs at greedy K1.

code_findings.finding: MTP Source describes the complete candidate boundary. Partial target acceptance invalidates that full boundary and cancels an already submitted successor; original retirement then discards it.
Discard recovery resets continuation warm state and retires/reinstalls affected original Invocation carriers, so their capture state can be lost.

Each Graph range keeps two saved capture variants keyed by actual physical ports; a nonmatching ready-input tuple may record again. Pending Source execution is reuse-only and rejects a missing prepared key.
code_findings.observed_limit: This auto process reports zero successor refusals, so the explicit missing-key refusal/re-prime branch is not demonstrated as the cause here.

code_findings.finding: Existing PreparationObservation already separates layout, batch IO binding, and replay preparation. Current stderr only publishes their combined cold_batch_seconds.

inferences_and_limits: The first quantified large item is capture/prepare churn: eight extra published capture recordings and +57.7115 ms published T2 cold preparation, about 48.3% of this pair's decode wall-time gap. This measures elapsed preparation, not CPU self time or GPU work.

Two discarded successors are consistent with the two extra graph calls and four extra target rows, while all generated IDs and acceptance records are identical. The logs do not identify each discarded graph's precise round/slot.

Capture loss after discard and physical tuple changes are concrete possible causes, but current logs do not identify the first mismatching port/range or attribute all eight extra recordings. Two saved variants alone does not prove eviction occurred in this process.

Seven published MTP intervals are roughly doubled, consistent with the seven successor publications. Step seconds start at submission and can overlap a preceding graph, so summing them cannot establish seven additional GPU executions.

The original-SDK auto control supplied by /root reproduces the same work and similar speed. This default-auto overhead predates the M2 paired-projection candidate; it must not be assigned to the fusion.

Auto and off here came from separate measurement windows; timing differences are an initial diagnostic, not a randomized same-window causal attribution. Capture/work counts and raw-output equality are direct observations.

Published prepare/step stderr omits cancelled successor observations, so its sums do not include every cost of the two discarded graphs. Compile and weight-load startup times are outside the reported decode interval.
